atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Use the `@tailwind` directive to insert Tailwind's `base`, `components`, `utilities` and `screens` styles.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use the `@apply` directive to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Use the `@layer` directive to tell Tailwind which layer a custom set of styles belong to.

atDirectives.name: @variants
atDirectives.description: Use the `@variants` directive to generate variants of your own utilities.

atDirectives.name: @responsive
atDirectives.description: Use the `@responsive` directive to generate responsive variants of your own classes.

atDirectives.name: @screen
atDirectives.description: Use the `@screen` directive to reference a media query by name instead of duplicating its value.
